to-tbig.label: GT big overs conceded per 100 overs, 2022–2026
to-tbig.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
to-tbig.filters: Overs of fifteen runs or more
to-tbig.query: WITH o AS (SELECT d.innings_id, d.over_num, SUM(d.total_runs) r FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.over_num), s AS (SELECT o.*, LAG(o.r) OVER (PARTITION BY o.innings_id ORDER BY o.over_num) prev, LEAD(o.r) OVER (PARTITION BY o.innings_id ORDER BY o.over_num) nxt FROM o) SELECT CASE WHEN i.bowling_team_id IN (14) THEN 'team' ELSE 'rest' END side, COUNT(*) overs, SUM(CASE WHEN s.r >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) big, AVG(CASE WHEN s.r >= 15 THEN s.nxt END) afterBig, AVG(s.r) avgOver FROM s JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = s.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2022 AND s.over_num BETWEEN 0 AND 18 GROUP BY side
